name: Cross-sectional neutral momentum — long leg (top-rank leaders)
rationale: Pure cross-sectional momentum: buy the relative strength leaders — assets whose N-day return ranks in the top percentile of the screened universe at bar close. Paired with the short-laggard leg (xsec-neutral-momentum-short-leg.json) the two legs form a market-neutral book: market beta cancels and the residual is the cross-sectional momentum premium (Jegadeesh–Titman 1993; documented survival at ~30d with ~125bps headroom on liquid crypto). The xsec_momentum_rank feature [0, 1] is a cross-sectional percentile rank of ret_Nd computed at bar close from the same universe — point-in-time, no survivorship look-ahead. Entry: rank above a fitted top-rank floor AND NOT in a crowded-funding regime (funding ceiling guards against the documented funding-spike-before-crash pattern). Vol ceiling keeps us out of crash/whipsaw regimes where momentum bleeds. Exit: rank drops below a fitted exit floor (leadership lost) OR the stop/TP fires. No magic numbers.
catalyst: Cross-sectional momentum leadership: relative-strength leaders outperform laggards at weekly-monthly horizon.
